name: SIZA TALKS Conversas Internacionais
description: Serralves hosts a three-day cycle of international architecture talks featuring architects from Norway, Portugal, Brazil, Spain, the US, Palestine, France, the UK, and Mexico.
longDescription:
The 2026 edition of Siza Talks focuses on the theme Conversas Internacionais, looking at architecture as a meeting point between geographies, cultures, and construction methods. Organised by Fundação de Serralves in collaboration with the Aga Khan Award for Architecture, the cycle takes the worldwide scope of Álvaro Siza's work as a starting point to examine contemporary practice across borders.

The programme runs over three days in the museum auditorium. Sessions open on 12 November at 19:00 with Kjetil Thorsen of Snøhetta. Talks continue on 13 November from 16:00 with Nuno Melo Sousa, Mariana Simas of Studio MK27, Alberto Campo Baeza, and Elizabeth Diller of Diller Scofidio + Renfro. On 14 November, presentations begin at 16:00 with Elias and Yousef Anastas, Anouk Legendre of XTU Architectes, Tony Fretton, and Carlos Facio of Colectivo c733.

Daily admission is 5 euros, with a 50 percent discount available for Serralves Friends, students, and seniors over 65.

Organizado pela Fundação de Serralves em colaboração com o Aga Khan Award for Architecture, o ciclo parte do alcance global da obra de Álvaro Siza para analisar a prática contemporânea além-fronteiras.

O programa decorre ao longo de três dias no auditório do museu. As sessões começam a 12 de novembro, às 19:00, com Kjetil Thorsen da Snøhetta. As conversas continuam a 13 de novembro a partir das 16:00 com Nuno Melo Sousa, Mariana Simas do Studio MK27, Alberto Campo Baeza e Elizabeth Diller da Diller Scofidio + Renfro. A 14 de novembro, as apresentações arrancam às 16:00 com Elias e Yousef Anastas, Anouk Legendre da XTU Architectes, Tony Fretton e Carlos Facio do Colectivo c733.

A entrada diária custa 5 euros, com 50% de desconto para Amigos de Serralves, estudantes e maiores de 65 anos.
